description: 固定14项客观程度的离线粗筛定义。关键词只给BM25，完整英文句只给向量检索；两条路线都只负责找候选，不判断相关程度或强度。

high_semantic_queries: The food is delicious, fresh, flavorful, and cooked well.
The dishes taste excellent and the ingredients are high quality.
low_semantic_queries: The food is bland, stale, badly cooked, or tastes terrible.
The dishes are undercooked, overcooked, flavorless, or poor quality.

high_semantic_queries: The staff are friendly, attentive, helpful, and provide prompt service.
Employees respond quickly and take good care of customers.
low_semantic_queries: The staff are rude, inattentive, slow, or ignore customers.
Customers receive poor service or have difficulty getting help.

high_semantic_queries: The meal is affordable, reasonably priced, and worth the money.
The portions and quality provide good value for the price.
low_semantic_queries: The restaurant is overpriced, expensive, or not worth the money.
The price is too high for the quality or quantity received.

high_semantic_queries: The restaurant is quiet, peaceful, calm, and suitable for conversation.
Customers can talk comfortably without raising their voices.
low_semantic_queries: The restaurant is loud and noisy, making conversation difficult.
Customers cannot hear each other or need to shout over the noise.

high_semantic_queries: The restaurant is crowded, packed, cramped, or extremely busy.
There are too many people and very little space between customers.
low_semantic_queries: The restaurant is uncrowded, spacious, and has plenty of room.
There are few people and customers do not feel cramped.

high_semantic_queries: Customers wait a long time in a line or queue before being seated.
Getting a table takes a very long time or feels like forever.
low_semantic_queries: Customers are seated immediately or wait only a short time.
There is no line and no meaningful wait for a table.

high_semantic_queries: The portions are large, generous, and provide plenty of food.
Serving sizes are substantial and enough to satisfy customers.
low_semantic_queries: The portions are small, tiny, skimpy, or do not provide enough food.
Serving sizes are much smaller than customers expect.

high_semantic_queries: Parking is easy, convenient, free, or plentiful near the restaurant.
The restaurant has a useful parking lot or many available spaces.
low_semantic_queries: Parking is difficult, limited, expensive, full, or unavailable.
Customers struggle to find a place to park near the restaurant.

high_semantic_queries: Dogs and other pets are welcome and treated well at the restaurant.
The restaurant provides a pet-friendly space or amenities for dogs.
low_semantic_queries: Dogs or pets are not allowed and the restaurant is not pet friendly.
Customers are refused service or seating because they brought a pet.

high_semantic_queries: The restaurant is suitable for families, children, and young kids.
Children are welcome and the restaurant offers helpful family amenities.
low_semantic_queries: The restaurant is unsuitable for children or is not family friendly.
Children are unwelcome, restricted, or have a poor experience here.

high_semantic_queries: The restaurant is romantic and well suited to a date or anniversary.
The atmosphere supports an intimate meal for two people.
low_semantic_queries: The restaurant is not romantic and is a poor place for a date.
The atmosphere makes an intimate date uncomfortable or unsuitable.

high_semantic_queries: The restaurant can comfortably accommodate large groups and parties.
Group dinners are handled well with enough space and suitable seating.
low_semantic_queries: The restaurant cannot accommodate groups or is too small for a party.
Large groups are split up, refused, or have difficulty dining together.

high_semantic_queries: The food is very spicy and has an intense heat level.
The dish is much hotter than most customers expect.
low_semantic_queries: The food is mild and has almost no heat.
The dish is not spicy even for customers who avoid heat.

high_semantic_queries: The restaurant, tables, and bathrooms are clean and well maintained.
The dining area is spotless, hygienic, and carefully maintained.
low_semantic_queries: The restaurant is dirty, filthy, sticky, or unsanitary.
Tables, bathrooms, or dining areas are poorly cleaned and maintained.
